programme.title: Horton Hears a Who!
programme.desc: In the jungle of Nool lives the elephant Horton, who has a vivid imagination and an angelic disposition.One day he hears a tiny particle floating in the air calling for help.It turns out that the city of Whosiowo, inhabited by microscopic Whos, is located on the pollen.The power here is held by Mayor Ned, who confesses to Horton that the city is in danger of destruction.He, in turn, tells the jungle inhabitants about this, but no one wants to believe him.The cynical Kanga even thinks that the honest elephant has lost his mind.Also the black eagle Vlad-I-Koff and the monkey clan of Wickershams mock him.Even Horton's best friend, Morton, doesn't believe what he says.Despite this, the elephant decides to save the inhabitants of Whosiów.

programme.title: A Real Pain
programme.desc: American David Kaplan (Jesse Eisenberg) and his cousin Benji (Kieran Culkin) set off on an expedition to Poland.They want to honor the memory of their beloved grandmother Dora.They begin their tour of her home country by joining the team of British guide James (Will Sharpe).Members of the group with Jewish roots visit places related to the history and culture of their ancestors.During the journey, tensions grow between the young men resulting from their different approaches to life.The director and screenwriter of the comedy-drama is Jesse Eisenberg, who also starred in the main role.He called his film "a love letter to Poland".His acting duo, Kieran Culkin, was awarded a Golden Globe.The photos were shot, among others, in Warsaw and Lublin.

programme.title: The Bride!
programme.desc: Chicago, 1930s. At the request of Frankenstein (Christian Bale), researcher Dr. Euphronious (Annette Bening) resurrects for him a woman (Jessie Buckley), a murder victim, pulled out of the grave.An odd couple like Bonny and Clyde quickly attracts trouble and has to flee the city.Detective Jake (Peter Sarsgaard) follows them, with his assistant Myrna (Penelope Cruz) helping him at every step.The revived dead woman and her companion cause chaos wherever they appear.Together they commit robberies and murders, and over time, the two outcasts develop a fiery romance.Mary Shelley, possessed by the voice of the writer, seeks destruction, but at the same time frees herself from the corset of social conventions.An ambitious reinterpretation of a horror classic with elements of Victorian horror and burlesque.

programme.title: Weapons
programme.desc: All but one of the students from the same class disappear without a trace that same night at 2:17.A mysterious event shocks the inhabitants.Many of them blame the children's teacher, Justine (Julia Garner).Alex (Cary Christopher), the only boy who did not disappear, wanders the school corridors alone.Paul (Alden Ehrenreich), a policeman addicted to alcohol, is unable to properly manage the investigation.Seeing this, the father of one of the missing people, Archer (Josh Brolin), tries to solve the mystery on his own.James (Austin Abrams), a homeless drug addict, is also involved in the case.The local community begins to search together for answers as to who or what is behind the disappearance and what is the fate of the missing children.

programme.title: Rumble Through the Dark
programme.desc: Jack Boucher (Aaron Eckhart), once an undefeated boxer, now lives in poverty, tormented by memories of the orphanage.In debt to Big Momma Sweet (Marianne Jean-Baptiste), he tries to win at the casino.

programme.title: Ainda Estou Aqui
programme.desc: Brazil, 1971. A military dictatorship is gaining strength in the country, and the lives of citizens are disrupted by detentions, disappearances and acts of violence.In these dangerous times, the Paiva family tries to live a peaceful life in Rio de Janeiro.Everything changes when one day the family patriarch, Rubens (Selton Mello), a former congressman, is summoned for a mysterious interrogation by military investigators.Soon, the officers arrest Eunice Paiva (Fernanda Torres), the mother of the family.She is kept in prison for 12 days and put under pressure to hand over friends and associates accused of opposition activities.The traumatic experience becomes the beginning of Eunice's profound transformation.After leaving prison, she is forced to find herself again - she fights for the truth as an activist.Its goal is to expose the government's illegal actions and fight for justice for thousands of victims of the regime.

programme.title: Too big for fairy tales 2
programme.desc: Waldek (Maciej Karaś) is going to spend his holidays in the Tatra Mountains.A trip to Podhale with her mother's new partner, Piotr (Paweł Domagała), without access to the Internet and her favorite entertainment, computer games, does not inspire optimism.There, he will also meet his eccentric aunt (Dorota Kolak) again.Fortunately, he can take his friends, Staszek (Patryk Siemek) and Delfina (Amelia Fijałkowska), with him.Once there, the boy learns that his biological father (Michał Żurawski) lives nearby.He decides to sneak out of the house to find his parent, with whom he has had no contact so far.Many adventures await him on mountain trails.

programme.title: Merry Madagascar
programme.desc: Friends from the New York Zoo - Alex the lion, Melman the giraffe, Gloria the hippopotamus and Marty the zebra - are still in Madagascar and dream of returning to their beloved home.Just before Christmas, they contribute to an unfortunate accident involving Santa Claus, who crashes his sleigh on the island.To make matters worse, the children's favorite suffers from amnesia.Four friends, with the help of penguins, plan to save Christmas and hand out gifts.They also want to take advantage of the situation to return to the zoo.Meanwhile, the penguins start a war with the reindeer... In the Polish version, they lent their voices to characters including:Artur Żmijewski, Małgorzata Kożuchowska and Piotr Adamczyk.

programme.title: Down with Love
programme.desc: The 1960s.Writer Barbara Novak (Renée Zellweger) comes to New York to publish her book To Hell with Love.The author convinces women to focus on their careers and treat sex and feelings the same way as men.Editor Vicki Hiller (Sarah Paulson) tries to set her up with the famous journalist, Catcher Block (Ewan McGregor), but none of the several meetings takes place.Eventually, Barbara's book gains popularity and becomes a bestseller.Then the roles are reversed and Novak rejects Block's subsequent proposals to meet.An angry journalist, whom the author called "the worst type of man" in a TV program, decides to take revenge on her.He begins to pose as astronaut Zip Martin to make her fall in love with him and ridicule her theory.He does not know that he himself is becoming an object of manipulation.

programme.title: A Real Pain
programme.desc: American David Kaplan (Jesse Eisenberg) and his cousin Benji (Kieran Culkin) set off on an expedition to Poland.They want to honor the memory of their beloved grandmother Dora.They begin their tour of her home country by joining the team of British guide James (Will Sharpe).Members of the group with Jewish roots visit places related to the history and culture of their ancestors.During the journey, tensions grow between the young men resulting from their different approaches to life.The director and screenwriter of the comedy-drama is Jesse Eisenberg, who also starred in the main role.He called his film "a love letter to Poland".His acting duo, Kieran Culkin, was awarded a Golden Globe.The photos were shot, among others, in Warsaw and Lublin.

programme.title: Priscilla
programme.desc: Young Elvis Presley (Jacob Elrodi) meets teenage Priscilla Beaulieu (Cailee Spaeny).He begins to prepare the girl for the role of his future wife.Over time, a serious feeling develops between them.However, life in the spotlight exposes their relationship to numerous tests, including from the star's numerous lovers.Priscilla, living detached from reality, slowly begins to learn about herself.Will her transformation affect the future of this marriage?Sofia Coppola returns with another story about female youth."Priscilla" is the result of the director's cooperation with the ex-wife of the American rock star, Elvis Presley.The director of "Curses of Innocence" and "Temptation" once again juxtaposes passion, romance and great love with the cruel realities of life.

programme.title: Arrival
programme.desc: Spaceships land in twelve different places on Earth.No one knows why the aliens chose these locations.The American military is trying to solve the mystery.For this purpose, the soldiers build a camp next to one of the mysterious objects.A talented linguist, Dr. Louise Banks, is called there.Together with Colonel G.T.Weber and physicist Ian Donnelly tries to find out what the real intentions of aliens are and determine whether humanity is in danger from them.Soon, Louise is sent to a spaceship to talk to representatives of an alien civilization.He must unravel the rules of the newcomers' language.He realizes that time plays a key role in the mysterious message.

programme.title: Destiny
programme.desc: The development of science and the emergence of time travel provide a chance to avoid the largest bomb attack in history.The explosion had occurred in New York ten years earlier.The risky task is undertaken by a secret government agency headed by Robertson.He realizes the danger.Since any interference with past events can irreversibly change the present, he develops a plan to eliminate the terrorist without side effects.He chooses a random agent to carry out the mission.He is to recruit a younger version of the criminal into his organization.At the same time, he makes surprising discoveries about himself.

programme.title: Macbeth
programme.desc: Macbeth returns from his war expedition.The witches predict a great future for him.The man's ambition and lust for power awaken, additionally fueled by his wife.However, his path to the throne will be bloody.

programme.title: A Complete Unknown
programme.desc: The year is 1961. Nineteen-year-old Bob Dylan (Timothée Chalamet) from Minnesota visits his idol - folk singer Woody Guthrie (Scoot McNairy) in the hospital.The artist suffering from Huntington's disease is cared for by his friend, Pete Seeger (Edward Norton).An aspiring musician has the opportunity to present one of his songs to experienced performers.They notice his talent.Thanks to the recommendation of a scene veteran, Dylan begins performing in New York folk clubs.On his way, he meets, among others, Joan Baez (Monica Barbaro), with whom he begins cooperation and, over time, also a romance.An aura of mystery, charisma and talent lead him to the peak of popularity.The breakthrough in his career was his performance at the Newport Folk Festival in 1965.The story of the life of a music icon.The director focused on the years 1961-1965.The film received eight Oscar nominations.Actors competing for the statuette included Timothée Chalamet, Edward Norton and Monica Barbaro.

programme.title: Den sidste viking
programme.desc: After fourteen years of imprisonment, Anker (Nikolaj Lie Kaas) is released from prison and has only one goal: to recover the loot from the last robbery.The problem is that the fortune was hidden by his brother Manfred (Mads Mikkelsen), who today introduces himself as John Lennon and suffers from a mental illness.His older sister Freja (Bodil Jorgensen) takes care of him.For the impulsive Anker, his relative's fragile psyche is a minefield and the only way to get his money back.Looking for the key to unlocking his brother's memories, the man starts cooperation with Lothar (Lars Brygmann), whom he met in the hospital, who proposes an unusual experiment to him.With the help of a team of strange characters, they reactivate the legendary band The Beatles... A full of absurdities, a reckless ride through the past, fractured psyche, brotherly loyalty and a world where logic no longer applies.Oscar-winning director Anders Thomas Jensen proves once again that, together with Mads Mikkelsen, he creates cult films.

programme.title: Insomnia
programme.desc: It's a polar summer in northern Alaska.Police officer Will Dormer (Al Pacino) arrives in the town of Nightmute with his partner Hap Eckhart (Martin Donovan).The men are to find the perpetrator of the murder of a seventeen-year-old girl.Will doesn't feel comfortable up north.The polar summer deepens his insomnia.The trail leads to writer Walter Finch (Robin Williams), who was friends with the victim.While chasing him in the thick fog, Will shoots his partner.Hap dies.In his last words, he accuses Will of doing it to prevent an internal investigation.Dormer covers his tracks by directing suspicions at Finch.A writer who witnessed Hap's murder begins to blackmail Will.Meanwhile, local policewoman Ellie Burr (Hilary Swank) is getting closer to discovering the truth about Hap's death.

programme.title: 28 Days Later...
programme.desc: A deadly virus was bred in one of the laboratories in Great Britain.A group of animal activists breaks in and frees the monkeys that were being studied.The animals, mad with rage, attack their saviors.The infected person loses control within 12 seconds and becomes a bloodthirsty beast.The epidemic is spreading extremely quickly throughout the country.28 days later, Jim (Cillian Murphy) wakes up from a coma while lying in the intensive care unit of a London hospital.Not understanding what happened, he wanders the deserted streets of the city.The terrified man is attacked by groups of angry people.He is saved from trouble by Selena (Naomie Harris) and Mark (Noah Huntley).All three escape from the city and end up at a military base commanded by Major Henry West (Christopher Eccleston).However, they are not safe there either.

programme.title: Ghostlight
programme.desc: Grieving construction worker Dan (Keith Kupferer) joins a local theater group working on a production of Romeo and Juliet.There are changes in his life.

programme.title: Robot Dreams
programme.desc: A lonely and timid Dog lives in colorful, bustling New York.Distrustful, he barricades himself in his apartment and looks at the noisy city with regret.The cure for his fears turns out to be a Robot, which the pet orders under the influence of an advertisement.When the parcel arrives, the dog assembles the sent model.It comes to life and immediately becomes the dog's best friend.From then on, the friends spend fun-filled days together.They go roller skating, eat hot dogs, listen to music and walk the streets of the metropolis.They are inseparable.However, their happy life together ends with a trip to the beach.Bathing in the sea has a tragic ending for Robot - he cannot move and has to stay in a sandy, closed area.The distraught Dog is unable to move it himself.However, she does everything to get him out of there.Once again he must overcome his fear of the world.His immobilized friend also dreams of the day when they will finally meet again.An Oscar-nominated animation based on a comic book by Sara Varon.

programme.title: A Royal Affair
programme.desc: 18th century.The young English aristocrat Caroline Matilda of Hanover (Alicia Vikander) marries the Danish king Christian VII (Mikkel Boe Folsgaard) as part of a political alliance.A smart, well-read and beautiful girl tries to cope with her new role.However, she finds no happiness with her exalted husband who shows signs of mental illness.When the German doctor Johann Friedrich Struensee (Mads Mikkelsen), whom the monarch has absolute trust in, appears at the court, the royal wife treats him with reluctance.Over time, however, she discovers how much she has in common with a progressive doctor, a follower of the ideas of the Enlightenment and a liberal who read the books of Voltaire, Rousseau and Locke.The two begin a passionate affair.Struensee gains more and more power and, with the support of Karolina Matilda, carries out innovative reforms.He makes many enemies.The court dignitaries, who have so far manipulated the king, do not intend to accept the loss of influence.They plot to get rid of the queen's lover.

programme.title: Sanctuary
programme.desc: Hal Porterfield (Christopher Abbott) orders room service at a posh hotel.Rebecca Marin (Margaret Qualley) shows up at the apartment to interview him for the position of general manager of this chain of facilities.Her questions become more and more personal and lead to a surprising ending.In reality, the woman is a dominatrix who follows the script prepared by Hal.However, the relationship does not follow the script ordered by the client.The woman decides to blackmail the rich man.She claims that she recorded a compromising sex tape with him.

programme.title: The Front Runner
programme.desc: Senator Gary Hart (Hugh Jackman) is extremely popular, especially among younger voters.In 1988, he decided to run for the presidency of the United States for the second time.He is considered by many to be the favorite.However, unexpectedly, his extramarital relationship with Donna Rice (Sara Paxton) comes to light.The media is publicizing this case, and Hart's career is in question... The director and screenwriter of the film, Jason Reitman, was nominated for the Festival Award at the Toronto International Film Festival.

programme.title: Guess Who
programme.desc: Dark-skinned Percy (Bernie Mac) is the head of the Jones family and always knows what is best for his loved ones.He also has an opinion on what the future husband of his daughter, Theresa (Zoe Saldana), should be like.Unfortunately, so far none of her admirers have gained his recognition.When Theresa tells him about her new boyfriend, stockbroker Simon (Ashton Kutcher), her father finally seems to support her choice.However, at the first meeting, the good impression disappears.It turns out that Simon is... white.In addition, she does not ask Percy for her daughter's hand in marriage because he has already proposed to her.What's more, he wants to announce his engagement at the silver wedding of his future in-laws.Percy decides to make his daughter give up the marriage on her own.

programme.title: Ford v Ferrari
programme.desc: The victory in the prestigious race goes to the Ferrari team every year.Henry Ford II intends to dethrone the full-time champion.He thinks about building a car that will leave the competition behind.For this purpose, he asks for help from two specialists.One of them is the temperamental fast driving enthusiast Ken Miles.The second one is Carroll Shelby, who can boast of winning Le Mans, and some time ago, due to health problems, he gave up his driving career and took up car design.They both immediately take up the challenge, even though they know that there is a long way to achieve their goal.They quickly encounter resistance from officials.It turns out that they must immerse themselves in the world of ruthless bureaucracy to take part in the twenty-four-hour race.

programme.title: Lord Of The Flies
programme.desc: A film adaptation of William Golding's 1954 novel.A group of British boys on a desert island try to create fair rules.However, fear and power struggles lead to chaos and aggression.
